steps.speaker: Julien's Letter
steps.content:
You just came through DisCity's largest underground transport network.
If you had the chance to go above ground, you'd have seen a completely different side of Syndicate.

Grand buildings, meticulous design, stability, wealth, hope— everything was neat and orderly. 
This was West District's Inner Bay, the birthplace of DisCity's Hypercube industry.
People dammed the farthest end of DisSea, carving out some relatively stable waters. 
They then dug deep mines in Inner Bay.

steps.speaker: Julien's Letter
steps.content:
The Hypercube was the treasure they "stole back" with their wisdom from the fearsome DisSea. 

It was the only strategic resource in the era of Nightfall, 

and the bedrock of DisCity's prosperity and status.

steps.speaker: Julien's Letter
steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>People</color> were the foundation of Inner Bay's industry, 
and many talented workers gathered here.
Back then, mech technology wasn't advanced to penetrate Mania fields.
Senior technicians had to manually operate mechs to dig one mine after another.
In N.F. 84, the DisSea Explosion occurred, giving birth to BR-000.
By the time the Broken Frontline was formed, 95% of Inner Bay had been contaminated.
Hypercube production plummeted, hitting DisCity's economic and political status hard.

steps.speaker: Julien's Letter
steps.content:
Inner Bay's workers were the ones who stayed behind in the ravaged mining zone 
to help DisCity pull through its most difficult period. 
They formed militias to fight the emerging gangsters, guarded the remaining mines against 
further contamination, and gave it their all to boost Hypercube reserves.
Sorry for saying so much, but that was the West District we were once so proud of. 
The people back then were the noblest souls of the golden age. We all love Syndicate deeply.
Next, let's talk about BR-002, which is the Black Ring you want to investigate.

steps.speaker: Julien's Letter
steps.content:
In N.F. 104, automated mining tech became common across Eastside. 
On the other hand, due to contamination, outdated equipment and work injury compensation costs, 
Inner Bay was deemed a negative asset by the higher-ups and discarded.

But the workers didn't want to give up. 
They begged the company to keep the mines and outdated equipment, so as to preserve 
West District's economic lifeline.

steps.speaker: Julien's Letter
steps.content:
In the end, the company agreed to the workers' demands on the condition that they give up 
all claim to compensation. The two sides completed the handover of the largest mine W-31 
on November 25. Inner Bay won for Syndicate its own Hypercube mine.

But on November 28, an incident erupted in W-31.
Workers got trapped and contamination spread into the mine, 
which soon developed into a Black Ring—<color=#fb9259>BR-002</color>.

steps.speaker: Julien's Letter
steps.content:
We have very little data on BR-002. BR-000 and 002 were too close in proximity, triggering the mass spread of Mania. BR-000 expanded rapidly, and was barely halted at the FAC's third Broken Frontline.
The radiation from the contaminated zone continued to seep out, eventually covering all of Inner Bay.
The industrial zone became completely isolated from the outside world. Not even the FAC could penetrate this layer of contamination.
After a few years, they confirmed that the M-value inside disappeared, but could not confirm the reason why, hence they left. The survivors of Inner Bay, including their family members, total around 200 people.
Afterwards, the <color=#fb9259>Drifter Camp</color> was formed.

steps.speaker: Julien's Letter
steps.content:
As for those who were trapped in the mine, I could only confirm the names of 13,004 of them. 
<color=#fb9259>The Romanesque monument</color> was built in their honor.

You asked us about our relationship with BR-002—this is it.
I've also told you everything I know about BR-002.

If you want to know more, please go to the next page.
There's very little content on this page.

steps.speaker: Julien's Letter
steps.content:
Since you've made it this far, welcome to Shelter W-31.
Like I said, this is the easiest place for you to complete your mission. 
Once you leave the shelter, you can take a boat across Inner Bay to Mine W-31 in ten minutes. 
This is also the ruins of BR-002.

This was once the Corpseborne's base. You said the half that fled is great at hiding 
because it leaves no traces, since all the contamination gets transferred to the dead half.

steps.speaker: Julien's Letter
steps.content:
Well, lucky you, because the dead half is at the bottom of W-31.
Once you destroy this half, the other half will no longer be able to hide its contamination, naturally exposing itself. Rustfire will show you the way. 
The fighters here are at your command. 
This shelter, which has been a sanctuary for Inner Bay's workers since before the Broken Frontline, has got your back. 
We couldn't let go of our past, so we came back and did what even the FAC couldn't.
We used Inner Bay technology to resurrect the shelter, and stockpiled enough Hypercubes to hold off the contamination.

steps.speaker: Julien's Letter
steps.content:
The battle might be tough, but you can always come back to recharge your supplies.
If I told you this is your reward for helping the Drifter Camp, you wouldn't believe me. 
You're always such a cautious person.

Yes, we each have our own goals, but they're all for the future of Syndicate.
If you're willing to guard our secret from your superiors...
Then please read on.
There's only one line on this page.
Her head lowered, she chokes and shudders, no longer able to string together a full sentence.
You freeze for a second. Just as you're about to flip to the next page, the paper sticks to your hand. To your incredulity, you realize the ink is moving. You hear a woman's voice...
You're reading too slowly, Mr. Chief. Let me read it out loud for you.
steps.female_content: You're reading too slowly, Ms. Chief. Let me read it out loud for you.

steps.content: A women's voice snaps you out of your shock. The ink blots suddenly jump off the paper—some wrap around your hand, and some gather in front of you.
Incredibly, they shapeshift into the form of a human.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: I came here together with you, Chief.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: I read the rest already. Let me tell you their real motive.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: They want to take over a Black Ring and turn it into a mining zone for West District. Their next step is to engage in smuggling, and collude with the Outlands to undermine the economy and security of DisCity!

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: This is a serious crime! All of DisCity's Hypercubes belong to the state. Any Black Ring ruins or leftover mines in West District are under the jurisdiction of the Executive Committee. <color=#fb9259>Nirvana</color> is the only company legally entitled to use them!

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: Chief, you've made a great discovery. Come, let's wipe out these traitors together.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: Wait? You want to cover for them? You've made new friends since the Legion rebellion?

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: You want to betray us, the 9th Agency, and DisCity again?
The ink wraps around your neck. You can feel the power of a Sinner from it.
In front of you is just a phantom of ink coalescence. The real mastermind is behind you!
You cast your shackles backward, piercing through a larger mass of black ink. A figure dodges your attack. The ink raises her high, and she looks down at you.
Haha. Good reaction.
Relax. I didn't come to fight. I just wanted to make this once-in-a-lifetime encounter with you more dramatic and memorable. Now, let's have a proper introduction.
Hello, Chief. I'm the shelter liaison.
I'm also a Rustfire publicist, Syndicate war correspondent, renowned Drifter Camp author, DisCity ghost writer, and the greatest romantic poet of our time.
I am Raye, but you can call me by my beautiful pen name...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Raven</color>. I write poems with darkness, and I've come to record this magnificent mission.
